tenderSchedule.title: TENDER FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICE FOR PROVIDING COACHING FOR KAS GAZETTED PROBATIONERS CIVIL SERVICES EXAMINATIONS TO MINORITY STUDENTS AT HAJ BHAVANA, BENGALURU
tenderSchedule.description: Director,DIRECTORATE OF MINORITIES is inviting online e-Tender for providing KAS GAZETTED PROBATIONERS Civil Services coaching under two tender document system / two parts (Technical and Financial Bid) from reputed and prestigious training Institutions registered in India who have adequate resources and experience.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Minorities, Maulana Abul Kalam Aazad Bhavan, No.16 C, Millers Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bangalore-560 052.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

All the terms, conditions, eligibility criteria, specifications, obligations and other provisions stipulated in the tender document, along with any amendments, corrigenda or clarifications issued by the competent authority from time to time, shall be applicable to the bidder and shall be strictly complied with throughout the tendering process and during the execution of the contract. The bidder shall be deemed to have read, understood and accepted all such terms and conditions upon submission of the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The candidates who have undergone training from the bidding coaching institute must be selected for KAS/GP Services in the last 3 KPSC/KAS/GP Notifications

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Work Done Certificate
Satisfactory Performance Certificate
Others -- The bidder should furnish all the below documentary proof and details as per As per the format enclosed at Annexure 1
Others -- The result sheet of Students who have secured appointment in various posts of KPSC/KAS Exams
Others -- Admission details of the students  studied  in  respective coaching institute, such as fee paid receipt/ institute id card

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have trained students in training course (for prelims, mains, essay writing & interview guidance) for KPSC/KAS examinations in the last 3 years. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Work Done Certificate
Satisfactory Performance Certificate
Others -- Details of the students as per  the  format enclosed at Annexure 2 & Payment receipts of the students to the institutes

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have an experience in KPSC/KAS civil services pre- examinations training courses in the offline mode from the last 3 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: GST Registration
Others -- Self-declaration containing year wise list of no. of trained candidates
Others -- registration copies if any or related document to prove the offline existence of the institute from past 3 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have minimum 10 full time faculties with a minimum of 5 years teaching experience in KPSC/KAS Civil Services examinations

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Valid ESI certificate
Valid EPF Certificate
Others -- The bidder should furnish the list of faculty members along with Self declaration containing faculties name, address & qualification
Others -- certificate of experience issued by the coaching institutes
Others -- The bidder should furnish the list of faculty members as per annexure -4
Others -- PF/PT/TDS/ESI and Offer letter of the faculty also to be uploaded under e- procurement portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institutions must have own set of study materials along with good quality of the content & also should have conducted its own exclusive test series for both prelims and mains for KPSC KAS Examination (Karnataka State) for past 3 KAS notifications

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- One set of own study material with good binding also copies of the test series should be provided for evaluation before the last date for submission
Others -- soft copies of the same should be uploaded under the e-procurement portal
GST Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidding firm should have its own Online Platform on Android or its own website accessible on windows OS and an app with downloads. Entire video lectures for each Subject wise, Chapter wise and concept wise should available to access. Online Test series with all the chapter wise test papers should be available in the online platform. Coaching Institution should have its own Online Management Information System (MIS) on candidates trained course wise, Centre wise, project wise with evaluation marks etc to enable Directorate to monitor the programs on line

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish the details of App on android or website details operational on windows OS
Others -- Documents regarding presentation of digital content should be uploaded in e-procurement of minimum 10-20 Pages.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited report, Turnover certificate certified by CA, Balance Sheet and P&L Accounts statements & ITR filed for the last three years.
Certificate of Incorporation/Registration certificate under society/Partnership deed, any other registered document & GST Reg Certificate
The bidder shall upload all documents, certificates and supporting records specified in the tender document along with the bid.

itemList.itemName: Cost per candidate Inclusive of all applicable taxes & study materials for training of KAS GAZETTED PROBATIONERS Prelims, Mains examinations which should also include following food, study materials, stationary, test series, interview guidance, essay writing, Mentors & coordinator charges, personality development, stress management, motivational sessions and any other expenses
